Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30008.json runs/final-case-30008-r3

input.description: Start AliasBreaker campaign for case-30008 run r3
Get diagnostics for case-30008 run r3

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r3 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot t=31.12 gives max separation for pairs 0-2 and 1-2, cheapest way to start narrowing the three candidates"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r3 --slot 3 --why "Candidate 1 is effectively eliminated, remaining live pair is 0 vs 2, slot 3 at t=35.59 is the earliest of the tied maximal-separation slots for that pair"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30008-r3 --slot 4 --why "Support already crossed to candidate 0 after only two observations, taking one confirmation point at the earliest remaining slot to guard against a single noisy measurement misleading the resolution"

content.text: Confirmed. Support remains 1.0/0.0/0.0 for candidate 0 (P≈9.278d) — a decisive, well-confirmed resolution. Finalizing.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30008-r3 --why "Candidate 0 at period 9.278 days reached support 1.0 after two discriminating observations and held through a confirmation point, while candidates 1 and 2 were driven to chi2 above 160 and 300, a clean and stable resolution"
input.description: Finalize campaign for case-30008 run r3

content.text:
Campaign complete for `case-30008` (run `final-case-30008-r3`):

- **Resolved**: candidate 0, period ≈ 9.278 d
- **Support**: 1.0 (threshold θ = 0.997)
- **Observations used**: 3 of 6 (slots 0, 3, then a confirmation at slot 4)

Sequence: slot 0 (t=31.12) eliminated candidate 1 and left candidates 0/2 as the live pair; slot 3 (t=35.59) drove support to 1.0/0/0; slot 4 (t=36.35) was a confirmation point per protocol since resolution crossed after only two observations — support held firm, so finalized without spending the remaining 3 slots.
